test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question: Which statement is NOT correct according to the passage?

options.text: Since 1950, world population was growing at its a slowest speed.
The countries of Asia will contribute more than half of the increase anticipated through 2050.
The population of 61 countries will decrease by 1% or more between 2022 and 2050.
World population is estimated to reach 10.4 billion in 2100.

solution:
The correct answer is option 2), i.e., 'The countries of Asia will contribute more than half of the increase anticipated through 2050.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The **first** sentence of the fourth paragraph says that "The world's population was growing at its slowest pace since 1950, having fallen below 1% in 2020, UN estimates showed." As it matches, therefore, option 1 is correct.
 
• The first sentence of the **eighth** paragraph says that "**Countries of sub-Saharan Africa** are expected to contribute more than half of the increase anticipated through 2050." As the highlighted portion does not match, therefore, option 2 is incorrect.
 
• The first sentence of the **ninth** paragraph says that "However, the population of 61 countries is projected to decrease by 1% or more between 2022 and 2050, driven by a fall in fertility." As it matches, therefore, option 3 is correct.
 
• The first sentence of the **second** paragraph says that "The world's population, estimated to reach 8 billion by November 15 this year, could grow to 8.5 billion in 2030, and 10.4 billion in 2100, as the pace of mortality slows, said the report released on World Population Day." As it matches, therefore, option 4 is correct.
 
• Therefore from the above sentence, we can certainly say only option 2 is incorrect.
 
• Hence, the only possible answer is option 2.
